AI response: ### Source Evidence Disclosure This assessment is conducted strictly on the **provided source evidence, verified repository artifacts, commit hashes, model cards, and release metadata** supplied in your prompt. Consistent with your operational record, no independent web browsing or live network research was executed during this turn. --- ### Candidate Assessment & Ranking | Rank | Model / Repo | License | Size / Runtime | Fit for Immediate ARM64 Evaluation | Key Caveats | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1** | [dish2calories](https://github.com/AmirrrezaZ/dish2calories)
`commit 23858d3` | MIT (code + weights) | 16.75 MB ONNX
CPU `onnxruntime` | **Highest** (Immediate baseline & mass-head fusion) | Restricted 75-ingredient vocabulary (lacks pasta/bread/soups); side-view training bias; direct macro calculation is hardcoded (4/4/9). | | **2** | [plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision)
`commit d569006` | MIT code / **Research Only** weights | 33.99 MB ONNX
CPU `onnxruntime` | **High** (Offline comparative benchmark only) | **Non-redistributable / Research-Only** due to Food-101 rights; requires exact inversion of standardized log-targets; sensitive to camera distance/zoom. | | **3** | [calorie-lens](https://huggingface.co/shalev396/calorie-lens)
`rev f0d34a6` | MIT + Apache 2.0 (DINOv2) | 378.58 MB Safetensors
PyTorch / Transformers | **Deferred / Phase 2** (High complexity & compute load) | 94.6M parameter DINOv2-B backbone; heavy RAM/CPU footprint on Pi 4 (~1.5–2.5GB RSS with activations & TTA); setup/runtime overhead. | | **4** | [nutriconsistnet](https://huggingface.co/arunapb/nutriconsistnet)
`rev 2a3d367` | CC-BY 4.0 | 98.6 MB (incomplete) | **Disqualified** | Weights and `train_means.npy` only; missing model architecture class in repo (unrunnable standalone). | | **5** | FoodCNN / FoodLMM / ByteBite | Mixed / Proprietary / Unclear | >87 MB to 7B+ | **Disqualified** | FoodCNN has unverified split provenance; FoodLMM (7B+ SAM) is impossible on Pi 4 CPU; ByteBite has no license or released TFLite assets. | --- ### Priority Strategy: Does CalorieLens Deserve First Priority? **No. CalorieLens should NOT be run first.** 1. **Resource Saturation on Raspberry Pi 4 ARM64:** - [calorie-lens](https://huggingface.co/shalev396/calorie-lens) is a 94.6M parameter DINOv2-B vision transformer (378.58 MB `.safetensors`). Under PyTorch 2.x on ARM64 CPU with 378×504 resolution and mirrored TTA, execution will consume an estimated 1.5–2.5 GB RSS (threatening the ~3.3 GB available system RAM) and cause severe CPU thermal throttling / multi-second latency per image. - In contrast, [dish2calories](https://github.com/AmirrrezaZ/dish2calories) (16.7 MB) and [plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision) (34.0 MB) together total **50.7 MB**, well under the 64 MiB ceiling, and operate cleanly within a **≤512 MiB RSS** budget under CPU `onnxruntime` with 1–2 threads. 2. **De-risking the Evaluation Harness:** - Running the lightweight ONNX models first establishes and validates the data pipeline, the frozen 10 N5 and 12 ECUST image loaders, the metric scoring adapters, and the mass-fusion baseline with zero dependency volatility. 3. **Decoupled Portion Estimation:** - The primary systemic challenge in calorie estimation is portion mass. [dish2calories](https://github.com/AmirrrezaZ/dish2calories) provides an isolated, standardized mass output head (`(raw * scale) + mean`) that can be tested immediately for **mass-only fusion** with existing A1 component densities, bypassing vocabulary mismatch risks. CalorieLens should remain a secondary candidate to evaluate only after the ONNX pipeline produces verified baseline metrics. --- ### Assessment of Preplan Action The proposed PREPLAN ACTION is sound, appropriately bounded, and follows strict test-first isolation: 1. **Pre-execution Verification:** Verifying the standardized log-target decoder from [simonkundrik/plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision) against the model export source before running evaluations prevents silent arithmetic errors in energy/macro decoding. 2. **Dual-Endpoint Architecture:** Splitting model outputs into (a) Direct end-to-end calories/macros and (b) Mass-only fusion (model-predicted mass + retained A1 densities/components) allows proper attribution of errors between density/composition recognition and physical mass estimation. 3. **OOD Generalization Guard:** Testing mass heads against both N5 (10 images) and ECUST (12 images: 6 old + 6 new) ensures models are evaluated on out-of-distribution geometry, preventing over-indexing on N5 plate layouts. 4. **Licensing & Redistribution Isolation:** Explicitly isolating [plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision) weights as research/diagnostic-only ensures compliance with Food-101 restrictions without polluting production artifacts. --- ### Structured Review Verdict - `MUST_FIX:` none - `SHOULD_FIX:` 1. **Preprocessing Pipeline Isolation:** Ensure the preprocessing unit tests strictly enforce separate pipelines: [simonkundrik/plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision) requires `uint8` RGB NHWC (as resizing/normalization is embedded inside the ONNX graph), whereas [AmirrrezaZ/dish2calories](https://github.com/AmirrrezaZ/dish2calories) requires `float32` NCHW (PIL bilinear 256×256 square with ImageNet normalization). Do not use a shared image transform. 2. **Decoder Ground-Truth Unit Tests:** Implement synthetic unit tests for the `plate-vision` quantile decoder (verifying index 1 median output and log inversion) and the `dish2calories` standardized mass decoder (`scale`/`mean` lookup) before running against real dataset images. 3. **Thread and Memory Bounds Enforcement:** In `onnxruntime.SessionOptions()`, explicitly set `intra_op_num_threads = 2`, `inter_op_num_threads = 1`, and `execution_mode = ExecutionMode.ORT_SEQUENTIAL` to prevent CPU core starvation on the host. 4. **License Tagging in Manifest:** Tag [simonkundrik/plate-vision](https://github.com/simonkundrik/plate-vision) clearly with `license: "research-only-non-commercial"` in the test manifest to guarantee it cannot be selected as an exportable mobile/production asset. - `QUESTIONS:` none - `AGREEMENT_STATUS:` agree
